'''Ogo Nan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] during the time of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. He was hired by [[Mika Anjiliac Chiera]] to fake an assassination attempt on him in an attempt to distract his father, [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]]. Nan was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] after destroying one of Popara's [[H-3PO]] droids.
